name: github-autosync
description: GitHub AutoSync: menu bar app that auto commits, pulls and pushes chosen git folders across computers (Electron + React)

scripts.pack: npm run build -w desktop && npm run pack -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
